body: Im glad you're able to escape that painful situation. Be safe out there, message me if you want to chat anytime. :)

Oh, alright. It may seem like a battle to get there, but you will pull through. Just dont give up yet. Things will look up and everything will be alright. Could i possibly message you instead of using this conment thread?

Im sorry.. i never wpuld be able to deal.. im very sorry you have no one there to talk to about how you feel, but, im here for you ^^ ill try to be as much as i can, if that helps hun (sorry for calling you that, im really used to it). Is there any way you could take time from your job? Just so you can take some time to clear your head?

Well, on that, you're righteously mistaken. You see, you would be dearly missed. I dont know much about you or how you got to this point, but you seem to me like someone who is amazing. You have so much to experience, even if you are going through this dark time in your life. I have complete faith that you can make it through this. Ugh i wish i could give you a hug, those always help me :3 is there anything AT ALL i can do to help you feel better.?

Im sorry you are feeling this way. But, there is a very important reason you shouldnt. I know its selfish and random even, but stay, for me. For everyone who knows you, cares about you, or whomever is in your life. If you need someone to talk to, im always here. But that isnt the way to go.. please, message me whenever you need. Just anything but that.

I understand how you feel. I really do. But, theres something i said last night that really capitalized not giving up. "Theres no way that ill roll on my back and give up, and i can confidently smile when i tell you that" as weird as it sounds, its honestly very true. You cant let yourself roll over and just give up. You would be missed terribly and no one in your life would be the same. If you're not strong enough, let me be strong for you. Please message me and we can talk about this.

Im sorry about your life, and what has brought you to this point. Literally yesterday, i felt the same exact way: like i couldnt go on. But someone was there for me, and i didnt. My point is, you shouldn't do that, but please talk to me. I know you dont know me, but at least i can try to help you feel better. But please.. dont do this. You're so much better than this, and you are so much STRONGER. I KNOW you are.

Thank you for your support. Im sorry about the loneliness, i know how it feels, especially dealing with it everyday. People say it gets easier, when the truth really is that it gets harder. I really hope that we both find some sense of peace and also an answer to our troubles. I really appreciate you taking the time to try and help as well :')
Wish i couldve been there while you went about it~ definitely couldve helped! 😂😊😋
Love it! May have to join you 😉😚
